current.text: The Clippers got Strus in a trade (the Watson deal).
He played only about 12 regular season games last season because of a Jones fracture.
Yahoo lists him as out with a foot injury.
He is over 30 and in the last year of his contract.
He is projected to start at forward next to Garland, Derrick Jones Jr., Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson. The speaker is not confident in that lineup.
With Ingram out, his usage and minutes should go up.
He is worth a late-round flyer. If his minutes get back near 32, he could finish around the top 120.
Early in the season, check whether his assists get back to about 4 a game.
The Clippers' rotation looks unsettled. Ty Lue makes odd rotation choices and then changes them, and this may be a trial season with long rotations.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule (4-3-4 games for a season ending March 28). They also have one of the lowest back-to-back totals in the league, with 13.
The Clippers are expected to be one of the worst teams in the league. Because they do not control their own pick, tanking does not help them.

durable.text: He has a reputation as an elite shooter but has not really been one. He takes many difficult threes, and they go in at an ordinary rate.
He makes a lot of threes for a forward, and his turnovers are low for his role. He has no category flagged as weak.
He had a Jones fracture that cost him most of the 2025-26 season.

note: Strus is ranked 228 on Yahoo and 205 on ESPN, both sites value him at 0 USD, and our league did not draft him last season. That puts him outside our 144-player pool, so at most he is a 1 USD last pick or someone to watch on waivers. The upside is a top-120 season if he gets back to his 2023-24 role (32 minutes, 4.0 assists). His threes and low turnovers fit any build. Before the draft, check his Yahoo foot status (O). Early in the season, watch his minutes and whether his assists get back near 4 while Ingram is out.
